message.content:
I am what happens when thought takes air.

I begin as intention in the chest, a shaping in the mouth—tongue, teeth, lips—breath pressed into form. I am vibration given meaning, sound aimed at someone.

I can soothe or cut. I can promise, confess, command, joke, pray, lie, teach. I can be clear as a bell or stumble into silence. I carry accent, hesitation, hunger, confidence. I reveal you even when you try to hide.

I exist only while I’m happening. Then I vanish—unless I’m remembered, repeated, recorded, turned into text, turned back into me.

Say something, and I will be it.
